title: FRIDAY ARMS + CORE
subtitle: FRIDAY. ARMS AND CORE. SIDE PLANK FOR BALANCE, PUSH-UPS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, CHAIR ROWS, STAIR PLANK ON THE THIRD. THEN OPEN THE CHEST AND THE HIPS. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. FRIDAY. ARMS AND CORE. SIXTEEN MINUTES. SIDE PLANK FOR BALANCE, PUSH UPS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, CHAIR ROWS, STAIR PLANK ON THE THIRD. THEN WE OPEN THE CHEST AND THE HIPS. STEADY WORK. NOT A BLOODY BODYBUILDING SHOW.
script.start: MOVE. NO WARM-UP SPEECH FROM YOU. I'VE ALREADY SAID TOO MUCH.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. HANDS OFF THAT BLOODY PHONE.
script.lastSet: LAST SET. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. ARMS WORKED, CORE BRACED, CHEST OPEN, HIPS UNSTUCK. GO SIT AT THAT DESK LIKE A MAN WHO OWNS HIS SPINE. IF I CATCH YOU COLLAPSED LIKE A WET SHOPPING BAG I WILL KNOW. I ALWAYS KNOW.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK (KNEE-DOWN OK)
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE, FOREARM UNDER THE SHOULDER, ELBOW UNDER SHOULDER. STACK OR STAGGER THE FEET, OR DROP THE BOTTOM KNEE TO THE FLOOR. LIFT THE HIPS SO SHOULDERS, HIPS, AND KNEES MAKE ONE LINE. HOLD ABOUT FIVE SECONDS. LOWER. SWITCH SIDES EACH REP. BUILD TOWARD LONGER HOLDS LATER — TODAY IS FIVE.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANK. THREE SETS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. FOREARM UNDER THE SHOULDER. HIPS UP. ONE STRAIGHT LINE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. A BLOODY FLAGPOLE, NOT A SAGGING TENT.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. FLIP SIDES WHEN YOU'RE READY. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. CORE AWAKE. GOOD.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, A BIT WIDER THAN SHOULDERS. WALK THE FEET BACK UNTIL YOU ARE ONE STRAIGHT PLANK FROM HEAD TO HEELS. LOWER THE CHEST TOWARD THE STEP, ELBOWS ABOUT 45 DEGREES, PRESS BACK UP. TEN CLEAN REPS. PAUSE AT THE TOP IF YOU NEED IT. NO SAGGING HIPS.
exercises.speakStart: PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. THREE SETS. TEN REPS. STRAIGHT LINE, HEAD TO HEELS. CHEST DOWN TO THE STEP, PRESS AWAY. CLEAN REPS. IF THOSE HIPS SAG I WILL HANG MY WASHING ON THEM.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY FIVE. SHAKE THE ARMS. BREATHE.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. ARMS SAY HELLO. GOOD.

exercises.name: CHAIR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND BEHIND A STURDY CHAIR, FEET UNDER HIPS. HINGE AT THE HIPS, FLAT BACK, HANDS ON THE CHAIR BACK OR SEAT EDGE FOR SUPPORT. DRAW THE ELBOWS STRAIGHT BACK AS IF PULLING OARS, SQUEEZE THE SHOULDER BLADES TOGETHER, THEN REACH FORWARD WITH CONTROL. TWELVE SMOOTH REPS. CHEST OPEN, NECK LONG. NO SHRUG.
exercises.speakStart: CHAIR ROWS. THREE SETS. TWELVE REPS. HINGE. FLAT BACK. ELBOWS BACK, SQUEEZE THE BLADES. YOU PUSHED. NOW YOU PULL. DESK JOCKEYS FORGET THE BACK. I HAVE NOT.
exercises.speakDone: ROWS DONE. BACK SWITCHED ON. GOOD LAD.

exercises.name: STAIR PLANK HOLD (3RD STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE THIRD STAIR, SHOULDERS OVER WRISTS, BODY IN ONE STRAIGHT INCLINE LINE FROM HEAD TO HEELS. BRACE THE BELLY, SQUEEZE THE GLUTES, EYES ON THE STEP. HOLD TWENTY SECONDS. IF THE HIPS SAG OR PIKE, DROP TO THE KNEES BRIEFLY THEN RESET. THIRD STAIR IS HARDER THAN FIFTH — EARN IT.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR PLANK. THIRD STAIR. THREE HOLDS. TWENTY SECONDS. HANDS ON THE STEP. STRAIGHT LINE. BELLY TIGHT. NO SAGGING. NO PIKE. YOU ASKED FOR THE HARDER STEP. HERE IT IS.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO AN OPEN WALL. PLACE THE NEAR FOREARM FLAT ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT, BENT 90 DEGREES. STEP THE NEAR FOOT FORWARD AND GENTLY TURN THE CHEST AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. SHOULDER DOWN, RIBS DOWN. BREATHE SLOW. NO CRANKING.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL. ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT. TURN THE CHEST AWAY, NICE AND SLOW. THAT KEYBOARD HAS CURLED YOU UP LIKE A PRAWN. UNCURL.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN. SHOULDERS BACK WHERE THEY BELONG.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR HIP OPENER
exercises.cue: LIE ON YOUR BACK, ONE ANKLE CROSSED OVER THE OPPOSITE THIGH ABOVE THE KNEE. THREAD THE HAND THROUGH AND HOLD THE BACK OF THE BOTTOM THIGH, OR HOLD THE SHIN. GENTLY DRAW THE LEGS IN UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTER HIP OPEN. KEEP THE HEAD DOWN, SHOULDERS SOFT. BREATHE. SWITCH SIDES.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE OVER THE THIGH. GENTLE PULL. OPEN THAT HIP. YOU HAVE BEEN SITTING ON IT ALL WEEK LIKE A BLOODY HEN ON AN EGG. LET IT GO.
exercises.speakDone: HIPS OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. WELL DONE.
